explanation: Wrong search scope for "bg": recovered/native/hexrays-all/chunk_012.c:12756-12757 resolves it with DebugCachedCharacter::GetChar(v131) as the context, and v131 is bound at chunk_012.c:12575 to HUDControls +0x4c = the cached "HUDelements.controls.controls.Joystick" clip, while the reconstruction searches from m_currentRoot (+0x388). The width read at chunk_012.c:12758 (get_width()/20*0.5) is therefore taken from a different clip, so the joystick stick reach (unk_0c/unk_10) can be wrong or null-deref when "bg" is not inside the root scope.
